name: reckless-realms
description: Skills for developing the Reckless Realms game. Includes test, which starts a local test game from the current session's reckless-realms checkout with the client dev bridge enabled and connects to the bridge; triage, a supervisor that watches both Reckless Realms repos for needs-triage tickets and starts a worker session per ticket to claim, research, reproduce and spec it, then mark it AI READY; and supervise-implementation, a supervisor that starts a worker session per AI READY ticket to build it with sdlc:implement-issue, merges each PR as it is ready, posts one Discord note per release and cleans up.
